newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac says has full confidence in Juppe.
newsitem.headline: Chirac says has full confidence in Juppe.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac said on Friday he had "full confidence in the lucidity and courage" of Prime Minister Alain Juppe.

Juppe has come under fire recently from members of his own ruling coalition, prompting mounting speculation that Chirac might be prepared to replace him to boost the government's low standing in opinion polls.

"I have full confidence in the lucidity and courage of the prime minister and of the government to carry out this difficult task," of leading the country, Chirac told a news conference after a Franco-British summit.

Francois Leotard, the leader of the Union for French Democracy (UDF), the junior partner in the ruling coalition, said in an interview with daily Le Figaro earlier on Friday he believed Juppe's days as prime minister were numbered.
"Chirac is aware of Juppe's deficiencies. He knows he must (change prime ministers). In his mind, it's clear," Leotard told the conservative daily.
"If we continue this way, we'll be beaten in the legislative elections."
